evidence_items.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
Introducing Hurdle: Run agent evals on your API, skills, and docs
evidence_items.summary: Hurdle is an open-source npm library for agent evals. Run Claude Code and Codex against real tasks on your API, score each run with code checks, guards and an LLM judge, and see which models and conditions pass.
